Dear Tom,

I'm sorry to hear that you have been under a lot of stress and sleeping badly. Here are a few suggestions. First, make a proper study plan and balance work with rest. Second, take exercise regularly, such as walking or running, which helps you sleep better. Third, stay away from your phone before bedtime; listening to soft music works well. Besides, sharing your worries with friends or family can also help.

I hope you will feel better soon.

Yours,
Li Hua

answers.eng_wr_hs1_0046:
Dear David,

I'm glad that you want to know about the Spring Festival, the most important traditional festival in China. Before it comes, people clean their houses and put up red couplets. On New Year's Eve, families get together to enjoy a big dinner, and children usually receive red packets from their elders. During the festival, people visit relatives and friends, and beautiful fireworks light up the sky.

Come to China and spend the Spring Festival with my family! You will surely have a wonderful time.

Yours,
Li Hua
answers.eng_wr_hs1_0047:
Dear friends,

It is a great honor to speak on the topic Persistence and Dreams. Everyone has dreams, but dreams alone are not enough. Only with persistence can we turn them into reality. First, break your dream into small goals and work on them every day. Second, never give up when you fail, because every failure teaches you a lesson. Third, keep a positive attitude and believe in yourself.

Where there is a will, there is a way. Let's hold on to our dreams and keep moving forward!

Paragraph 1: The old man took the money with great gratitude and told Tom his story. He was a retired worker; his son worked far away, and he had lost his wallet on his way home, so he had not eaten for a whole day. Tom listened quietly and felt something tighten in his chest. Don't worry, sir. I'll come back with some food, Tom said. The old man held the five dollars tightly, thanking him again and again. Tom waved goodbye and ran towards home, feeling strangely warm inside even in the cold wind.

Paragraph 2: When Tom arrived home and told his mother what he had done, she had a special reaction: she smiled and said, You did the right thing. Hearing this, Tom felt relieved. His mother then prepared a bowl of hot noodles and a clean blanket, and together they walked back to the old man. The old man's eyes filled with tears when he saw them. On the way home, Tom held his mother's hand tightly, knowing that the warmth in his heart mattered far more than any present.

Paragraph 1: The race began, and something unexpected happened to Lin. He started well, but after 200 metres his head began to spin. Suddenly he stumbled and fell! Pain shot through his knee, and the other runners rushed past him. For a moment he wanted to stay on the ground. Then his coach's words echoed in his mind: Never give up. Gritting his teeth, Lin got to his feet and moved forward step by step. When the crowd saw him running again, the whole stadium stood up and cheered for him.

Paragraph 2: Although the result was not what he had hoped for, Lin learned something important from the race. He finished last, but as he crossed the finishing line, his teammates lifted him onto their shoulders. The coach told him that his courage was the real victory. On the way home, Lin smiled despite his painful knee. He understood that life is not always about winning; what truly matters is having the courage to finish the race you have started.
answers.eng_sm_hs1_0050: Online learning is increasingly popular because it allows students to study at their own pace and choose courses they are interested in. However, it also has disadvantages: students may feel lonely without face-to-face communication, and they need strong self-control to avoid distractions. Therefore, experts suggest combining online learning with traditional classroom learning to get the best results.
answers.eng_sm_hs1_0051: Volunteering is meaningful for high school students. By helping others, they learn important life skills such as communication, teamwork and problem-solving, and get to understand different people and cultures. Although some students worry that it takes up too much time, studies show that regular volunteers usually do better at school because they become more confident and responsible. Therefore, schools should encourage more students to take part in volunteer activities.
